academic_calendar.notes: Each semester includes a 2-week add/drop window at the start and a 3-week exam period at the end.

add_drop_policy: Students can swap electives within the first 2 weeks of a semester without approval. After that, changes require written approval from the department.
fees_policy: Tuition is due at the start of each semester. A late fee applies after a 2-week grace period. Fee clearance is required before hall tickets are released.
